title: Why Does Chilli Burn Your Mouth?
description: Why does chilli feel so hot even though it is not hot? The simple science of capsaicin and why milk helps more than water.
comment: How spicy can you eat? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why does chilli burn your mouth, even though it is not hot?
Chilli has a chemical called capsaicin.
It switches on the same sensors in your mouth that detect real heat, so your brain thinks you are burning.
Water does not help much, because capsaicin does not mix well with water. Milk can help, because its fat and protein can wash capsaicin away.
Rice, bread and a little sugar can also ease it.
And never rub your eyes after cutting chillies.
